verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's docs include runnable code examples: the function-calling guide has OpenAI-format examples (stream and non-stream), and the first-call guide gives a sample request in both OpenAI and Anthropic formats. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference, such as an in-browser try-it console or an explorable endpoint reference. missing for 10: interactive in-browser API explorer/try-it console, evidence of a structured endpoint-by-endpoint reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of the docs experience.
